WITH PARAMETROS AS (
    SELECT
        GREATEST(
            TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'),
            ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -3)
        ) AS DATA_INICIO,
        TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AS DATA_FIM
    FROM DUAL
),
CLIENTES_ELEGIVEIS AS (
    SELECT
        C.CODCLI,
        C.CODATV1,
        C.CODCIDADE
    FROM OKAJIMA.PCCLIENT C
    WHERE C.DTEXCLUSAO IS NULL
),
MOVIMENTOS_FORNECEDOR AS (
    SELECT
        F.CODIGOCLIENTE,
        F.CODIGOFORNECEDOR,
        SUM(NVL(F.VALORTOTAL, 0)) AS VALOR_LIQUIDO
    FROM OKAJIMA.OKJ_FATOFATURAMENTO_PBI F
    CROSS JOIN PARAMETROS P
    WHERE F.DATAFATURAMENTO >= P.DATA_INICIO
      AND F.DATAFATURAMENTO <  P.DATA_FIM
      AND F.CODIGOFILIAL IN ('2', '3')
      AND (F.CODIGORCAVENDA NOT IN (325, 4119, 4668, 7305)
           OR F.CODIGORCAVENDA IS NULL)
    GROUP BY F.CODIGOCLIENTE, F.CODIGOFORNECEDOR

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        D.CODIGOCLIENTE,
        D.CODIGOFORNECEDOR,
        -SUM(NVL(D.VALORTOTAL, 0)) AS VALOR_LIQUIDO
    FROM OKAJIMA.OKJ_FATODEVOLUCAO_PBI D
    CROSS JOIN PARAMETROS P
    WHERE D.DATADEVOLUCAO >= P.DATA_INICIO
      AND D.DATADEVOLUCAO <  P.DATA_FIM
      AND D.CODIGOFILIAL IN ('2', '3')
      AND (D.CODIGORCAVENDA NOT IN (325, 4119, 4668, 7305)
           OR D.CODIGORCAVENDA IS NULL)
    GROUP BY D.CODIGOCLIENTE, D.CODIGOFORNECEDOR
),
MOVIMENTOS_PASTA AS (
    SELECT
        M.CODIGOCLIENTE,
        NVL(TRIM(F.PASTA_CAMPANHA), 'SEM PASTA') AS PASTA,
        SUM(M.VALOR_LIQUIDO) AS FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M
    FROM MOVIMENTOS_FORNECEDOR M
    LEFT JOIN OKAJIMA.OKJ_DIMFORNECEDOR_PBI F
        ON F.CODIGO_FORNECEDOR = M.CODIGOFORNECEDOR
    GROUP BY
        M.CODIGOCLIENTE,
        NVL(TRIM(F.PASTA_CAMPANHA), 'SEM PASTA')
),
FAT_CLIENTE AS (
SELECT
    CAST(C.CODCLI AS NUMBER(16,0)) AS CODIGOCLIENTE,
    CAST(NVL(SUM(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M), 0) AS NUMBER(20,6))
        AS FAT_LIQUIDO_TOTAL_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'BU CGI'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_BU_CGI_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'BU PERFUMARIA'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'BU DISTRIBUICAO'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'DDF'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_DDF_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'OUTLET'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_OUTLET_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'PREDILECTA'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_PREDILECTA_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'SALAO DE BELEZA'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_SALAO_BELEZA_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'DESCONTINUADOS'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_DESCONTINUADOS_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA = 'SEM PASTA'
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_SEM_PASTA_3M,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN M.PASTA NOT IN ('BU CGI', 'BU PERFUMARIA', 'BU DISTRIBUICAO', 'DDF', 'OUTLET', 'PREDILECTA', 'SALAO DE BELEZA', 'DESCONTINUADOS', 'SEM PASTA')
                  THEN NVL(M.FAT_LIQUIDO_PASTA_3M, 0) ELSE 0 END)
         AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS FAT_OUTRAS_PASTAS_3M
FROM CLIENTES_ELEGIVEIS C
LEFT JOIN MOVIMENTOS_PASTA M
    ON M.CODIGOCLIENTE = C.CODCLI
GROUP BY C.CODCLI
),
CLASSIFICACAO_CLIENTE AS (
    SELECT
        CLI.CODCLI AS CODIGOCLIENTE,
        NVL(ATI.CODATIV, 0) AS CODRAM,
        CASE
            WHEN CLI.CODCLI IN (25638, 31182, 39488, 24489, 29470, 31045, 46157)
                THEN 'DDD 94'
            WHEN INSTR(UPPER(NVL(CID.DDD, 'ND')), 'DDD 91') > 0 THEN 'DDD 91'
            WHEN INSTR(UPPER(NVL(CID.DDD, 'ND')), 'DDD 93') > 0 THEN 'DDD 93'
            WHEN INSTR(UPPER(NVL(CID.DDD, 'ND')), 'DDD 94') > 0 THEN 'DDD 94'
            ELSE 'OUTROS'
        END AS DDD_GRUPO
    FROM CLIENTES_ELEGIVEIS CLI
    LEFT JOIN OKAJIMA.PCATIVI ATI ON ATI.CODATIV = CLI.CODATV1
    LEFT JOIN OKAJIMA.PCCIDADE CID ON CID.CODCIDADE = CLI.CODCIDADE
),
POTENCIAL_CLIENTE AS (
SELECT
    F.*,

    CAST(
        CASE WHEN P.DATA_INICIO < P.DATA_FIM THEN
            AVG(F.FAT_LIQUIDO_TOTAL_3M) OVER (
                PARTITION BY C.DDD_GRUPO, C.CODRAM
            )
        END AS NUMBER(20,6)
    ) AS POTENCIAL_TOTAL_3M,
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN P.DATA_INICIO < P.DATA_FIM THEN
            AVG(F.FAT_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M) OVER (
                PARTITION BY C.DDD_GRUPO, C.CODRAM
            )
        END AS NUMBER(20,6)
    ) AS POTENCIAL_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M,
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN P.DATA_INICIO < P.DATA_FIM THEN
            AVG(F.FAT_BU_CGI_3M) OVER (
                PARTITION BY C.DDD_GRUPO, C.CODRAM
            )
        END AS NUMBER(20,6)
    ) AS POTENCIAL_BU_CGI_3M,
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN P.DATA_INICIO < P.DATA_FIM THEN
            AVG(F.FAT_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M) OVER (
                PARTITION BY C.DDD_GRUPO, C.CODRAM
            )
        END AS NUMBER(20,6)
    ) AS POTENCIAL_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M
FROM FAT_CLIENTE F
INNER JOIN CLASSIFICACAO_CLIENTE C
    ON C.CODIGOCLIENTE = F.CODIGOCLIENTE
CROSS JOIN PARAMETROS P
)
SELECT
    F.*,
    CAST(ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN F.POTENCIAL_TOTAL_3M IS NULL OR F.FAT_LIQUIDO_TOTAL_3M <= 0
                THEN 0.50 * F.POTENCIAL_TOTAL_3M
            WHEN F.FAT_LIQUIDO_TOTAL_3M >= F.POTENCIAL_TOTAL_3M THEN 1.05 * F.FAT_LIQUIDO_TOTAL_3M
            ELSE F.FAT_LIQUIDO_TOTAL_3M + 0.50 * (F.POTENCIAL_TOTAL_3M - F.FAT_LIQUIDO_TOTAL_3M)
        END, 2) AS NUMBER(20,2)) AS META_TOTAL_3M,
    CAST(ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN F.POTENCIAL_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M IS NULL OR F.FAT_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M <= 0
                THEN 0.50 * F.POTENCIAL_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M
            WHEN F.FAT_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M >= F.POTENCIAL_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M THEN 1.05 * F.FAT_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M
            ELSE F.FAT_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M + 0.50 * (F.POTENCIAL_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M - F.FAT_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M)
        END, 2) AS NUMBER(20,2)) AS META_BU_DISTRIBUICAO_3M,
    CAST(ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN F.POTENCIAL_BU_CGI_3M IS NULL OR F.FAT_BU_CGI_3M <= 0
                THEN 0.50 * F.POTENCIAL_BU_CGI_3M
            WHEN F.FAT_BU_CGI_3M >= F.POTENCIAL_BU_CGI_3M THEN 1.05 * F.FAT_BU_CGI_3M
            ELSE F.FAT_BU_CGI_3M + 0.50 * (F.POTENCIAL_BU_CGI_3M - F.FAT_BU_CGI_3M)
        END, 2) AS NUMBER(20,2)) AS META_BU_CGI_3M,
    CAST(ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN F.POTENCIAL_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M IS NULL OR F.FAT_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M <= 0
                THEN 0.50 * F.POTENCIAL_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M
            WHEN F.FAT_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M >= F.POTENCIAL_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M THEN 1.05 * F.FAT_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M
            ELSE F.FAT_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M + 0.50 * (F.POTENCIAL_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M - F.FAT_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M)
        END, 2) AS NUMBER(20,2)) AS META_BU_PERFUMARIA_3M
FROM POTENCIAL_CLIENTE F
